'''Pashna Genko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] from [[Coral City/Legends|Coral City]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] who led the [[88th Attack Squadron]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] based at a [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|base]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
